description: Configure Docker Desktop's internal Docker Engine to use the subnet '192.168.200.0/24' for the default bridge network. You must do this by modifying the Docker Engine configuration in Docker Desktop settings (Settings > Docker Engine). Set the 'bip' (Bridge IP) property to '192.168.200.1/24'. After editing the configuration, apply the changes and wait for the engine to restart. Verify the change by checking the bridge network properties.
